cases.case: valid initialized inventory, semantic and extra critical inputs
cases.requirement: Same outcome and ordered selection; all content obligations covered; final seal completes
Original ordinary branch/check order unchanged; no semantic reuse
Reject before reuse; no initialization inferred from transport metadata

cases.case: semantic path missing from context inputs
cases.requirement: Retained complete row-equality check rejects
Reject via entry identity, fresh scan/original comparison or full-row equality

cases.case: nonsemantic source or extra input changed
cases.requirement: Original nonsemantic unchanged check rejects
Original full classification/member comparison or entry/final seal rejects
Original unchanged scanner rejects

cases.case: new object, resolution or journal changed
cases.requirement: Original independent content checks and final identity seal reject

cases.case: excluded metadata identity or family drift
cases.requirement: Original scanner comparison and seal reject; excluded bytes not reclassified

cases.case: dependency/target/root shadow, prefix sibling, missing leaf
cases.requirement: Original effective and dependency/target content reads unchanged; reject
Final identity/ctime snapshot comparison rejects
Final exact membership/directory/parent comparison rejects

cases.case: symlink or hard-link or mode/owner drift
cases.requirement: Original scanner/regular checks and final seal reject

cases.case: final seal or final lease check raises
cases.requirement: Exception propagates; no successful return or child launch
Each performs its own fresh scan, critical hashes and final seal; no reused prior result
Same base verification plus unchanged output-absence/singleton checks
Fail closed; first diagnostic precedence may differ

cases.case: transient concurrent writer or mutable authority during call
cases.requirement: Outside immutable/no-writer premise; no equivalence claim or permission to run
Same checks under unchanged caps; measure metadata overhead, do not assume speed or budget fit
